modules.base: Progress emission — internal helper for reporting migration events to a caller-provided callback.
modules.groups: Group migration — copy specific groups or all groups from source to target using the bulk group endpoint.
modules.users: User migration — copy specific users or all users from source to target, preserving role and group assignments.
modules.dashboards: Dashboard migration — copy dashboards and their share entries across environments; migrate all dashboards in bulk.
modules.datamodels: Data model migration — copy data model schemas and connection definitions from source to target; supports bulk migration.
